title: add benchmark-lab end-to-end workflow and reporting pipeline
author: Aisha Patel
description: Adds an end-to-end Benchmark Lab workflow: representative workload runners, profiling baselines, and a reporting pipeline that aggregates results into S3/BigQuery and publishes HTML reports. Motivation: reduce manual steps in benchmark generation and make profiling baselines reproducible across hardware variants. Changes include new workload runner orchestration (k8s jobs + local runners), adaptive sampling for profiling baselines, standardized metadata schema for runs, and a lightweight reporting service with CSV/HTML exports. Checklist: [x] add representative runners and config templates; [x] add profiling baseline collectors; [x] add reporting pipeline with BigQuery export; [x] add CI integration tests for runner smoke tests; [x] update docs and quickstarts; [x] performance regression tests added. Related Linear: ENG-21988 ENG-22055. This PR contains implementation, tests, docs, and example dashboards. See files_changed for details and review conversation for design decisions and follow-ups.
commits: feat(benchmark-lab): add e2e orchestrator and runner templates
feat(benchmark-lab): implement profiling baseline collector and metrics schema
feat(benchmark-lab): reporting pipeline with BigQuery/S3 exporters
test(benchmark-lab): add smoke tests for runners and reporting
docs(benchmark-lab): add quickstart and dashboard examples
ci: add benchmark-lab workflow to pipeline matrix
fix(benchmark-lab): handle kube job backoff and better retries
review_comments: Marcus Chen: Nice end-to-end shape. Two requests: 1) can we make the profiling baseline format backward compatible with the existing CSVs? 2) add a flag to disable BigQuery export for local dev.
Aisha Patel: Addressed both: added compatibility layer and --no-bq flag to pipeline; updated tests and docs.
Elena Rodriguez: Found a race in k8s job backoff handling; left suggestions to retry on transient API errors and improve logging.
Aisha Patel: Pushed fix to handle RetryAfter and exponential backoff, added more logging and a unit test for the backoff path.
Samir Gupta: CI flaky: benchmark-lab runner smoke failed once on macOS runner due to ephemeral port; re-run passed. Approving after green CI.
release_notes: Adds a new end-to-end Benchmark Lab workflow: representative workload runners, profiling baseline collectors, and a reporting pipeline with BigQuery and S3 exporters. This enables automated benchmark generation and standardized result exports for dashboards and regression tracking.
notes: Follow-ups: add RBAC policies for reporting service (ENG-22210), hook the reporting pipeline into Dashboard ingestion for per-model views (PM-432), and add GPU-type-aware sampling configuration. We also plan a follow-up PR to add Canary runs against Dedicated capacity.
merge_commit_summary: Squashed 7 commits into main; added benchmark-lab e2e pipeline, profiling baselines, exporters, tests, and docs. CI green after rerun.
